stories.title: Mumbai police deploy 500 personnel at Diljit Dosanjh concert after bomb threat
stories.summary: Mumbai police have deployed more than 500 personnel at Mahalaxmi Racecourse for actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh’s concert on Friday, November 27, following a threat email warning of possible attacks on the venue and Metro stations, officials said. Officials further said that Bomb Detection and Disposal Squad (BDDS) teams have also swept the venue, adding that entry checks will be carried out across all five gates instead of three, as per PTI.

stories.title: BMC clears 15-year deal with Raymond to turn Worli jetty into helipad
stories.summary: The BMC standing committee has cleared a 15-year public-private partnership (PPP) agreement with Raymond Ltd to convert a jetty built during the Mumbai Coastal Road project into a DGCA-licensed helipad at Worli. The proposal was cleared on Thursday. Located opposite Worli Dairy, the jetty was originally constructed as a temporary facility to transport construction material during the construction of the Coastal Road (South).

stories.title: Mumbai: Smoking dispute sparks attack on passenger aboard Kasara-CSMT slow local
stories.summary: In yet another attack in a moving suburban train , a middle-aged passenger was allegedly attacked in the eye by a few people after he objected to them smoking beedi onboard the Kasara-CSMT slow local train on Friday morning. The victim said that he was travelling towards CSMT in the luggage compartment, and he spotted a group of commuters smoking inside the running train, to which he objected.

stories.title: Bandra Terminus platform 5 to shut for 75 days from December 1, several trains diverted
stories.summary: Several train services will be disrupted for 75 days from December 1 as Western Railway shuts platform 5 at Mumbai’s Bandra Terminus for major repairs, with long-distance trains diverted or short-terminated and suburban services facing delays. The work will involve uprooting the tracks, removing the existing cement concrete apron and relaying the foundation in phases, railway sources said.

stories.title: Thane: Kalwa police seize Rs 94.78 lakh contraband, one arrested
stories.summary: 78 lakh, in an operation near Parsik Circle on the Mumbra-Bhiwandi highway . Officials, while briefing about the operation, said that the container driver has been arrested, while police are searching for seven other accused allegedly involved in the smuggling network.

stories.title: Mumbai's first large-scale waste-to-energy plant 93% complete, trials in Dec
stories.summary: The city's first large-scale waste-to-energy plant at Deonar dumping ground is nearing completion, with the BMC set to begin trial runs in December. The Rs 648-crore project is 93% complete and is expected to become operational in early 2027, after missing its original Oct 2025 deadline. The facility will process 600 tons of fresh municipal waste daily and is designed to generate up to 8 megawatts of electricity.

stories.title: Thane MACT awards Rs 1.1 crore to family of cop killed in 2022 road accident
stories.summary: 1 crore to the family of a 30-year-old police head constable who was killed after a trailer hit his motorcycle while he was on duty in November 2022. Tribunal Member R V Mohite directed the trailer owner and the vehicle's insurance company to jointly and severally pay the compensation, along with interest at 9 per cent per annum from the date of filing the claim petition.

stories.title: Western Railway plans Rs 98 crore Vande Bharat depot at Mumbai's Lower Parel, Dadar to get greater capacity to originate long-distance trains
stories.summary: The proposed facility will come up on around 55,000 square metres of land currently occupied by Central Railway's Store Depot. The project will be executed in two phases, with Rs 49 crore sanctioned for Phase I. The planned infrastructure includes two full-length pit lines, six stabling lines, two sick lines and one shunting neck.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai: Turbhe Bridge Closure Until March 2027 To Add To Commuters’ Woes; Motorists Face Lengthy Diversions
stories.summary: The closure, which came into effect from November 25, will force motorists to take alternative routes through Shiravane and Juinagar, potentially adding to travel time and traffic congestion, particularly during peak hours. The bridge is being shut as it has deteriorated beyond repair and has been declared dangerous.

stories.title: Mumbai Crime: 2 Forest Guards Arrested Under POCSO Act For Allegedly Molesting Minor Girls At Sanjay Gandhi National Park
stories.summary: The accused have been identified as Umesh Markande and Prabhu Chormare, both around 35 years old. According to the police, both guards had travelled from Aurangabad to Mumbai as tourists. 30 pm on Thursday. When the two minor girls were walking near a lake in the Vanrai train area, the guards allegedly followed them, asked for their phone numbers and touched them inappropriately.

stories.title: BMC to fine pigeon feeders ₹500 at Dadar, Mahim Chowpatty
stories.summary: For residents living around Dadar and Mahim Chowpatty, accumulated pigeon droppings, foul smells and concerns over unhygienic surroundings have become a persistent nuisance. After repeated complaints that open feeding has continued despite the closure of Dadar’s Kabutarkhana, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has now decided to station personnel at both locations to catch offenders and impose a ₹ 500 fine.

stories.title: Two arrested with charas worth ₹12.20 crore at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus in Mumbai
stories.summary: 20 crore from their possession at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (LTT) during an operation conducted on the intervening night of November 24 and 25. A case was registered on November 25 under Sections 8(c), 20(c) and 29 of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.

stories.title: GRP launches manhunt after woman alleges sexual assault inside ladies` washroom at Ghatkopar station in Mumbai
stories.summary: A woman was allegedly sexually assaulted by an unidentified person inside a ladies' washroom at Ghatkopar railway station in Mumbai on Thursday night following which a manhunt has been launched to identfy and nab the suspect, officials said on Friday. 20 pm on November 26, when the woman had gone to use the washroom on the CSMT end of platforms 2 and 3, according to a preliminary report by railway authorities.

stories.title: Mumbai weather: Mercury touches 35 deg C as city records moderate AQI of 118
stories.summary: Mumbai is likely to experience mainly clear skies on Friday, November 27, with warm and dry weather conditions expected across the city and its adjoining suburbs, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). No rainfall is forecast, and temperatures are expected to remain relatively comfortable during the early morning before rising through the day.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC announces five-day closure of wood-fired cremation facility in Kandivali West
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday announced that the wood-fired cremation facility at Dahanukarwadi crematorium in Mumbai's Kandivali West will remain temporarily closed for five days to facilitate chimney replacement work. The facility, which falls under the civic body's R South Ward, will remain shut from Saturday, November 28, to Wednesday, December 2, 2026, both days inclusive.

stories.title: Not just Saurav Das: CJP’s Dipke, Ranka also face Mumbai Police lookout circulars
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 26, 2026: Mumbai Police has issued Lookout Circulars (LoCs) against Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and co-convenors Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das in connection with an FIR registered over the party's allegedly unauthorised protest at Shivaji Park in Dadar on October 2, coinciding with Gandhi Jayanti.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai Crime: 4 Men Allegedly Smash Gold-Carrying Car’s Windows, Loot 16.4 Kg Gold Worth ₹20 Crore In Shiravane MIDC
stories.summary: The accused, who arrived in a WagonR, intercepted the car in the Shiravane MIDC area, smashed its windows with iron rods and forcibly fled with a bag containing gold biscuits, chains and other ornaments. 45 pm on November 26, when Lakshman Ghuro Mukhiya (55), along with two other employees of Chain and Chain company, was transporting gold from Zaveri Bazaar to the company's premises in Nerul MIDC.

stories.title: Thane Horror: Class 12 Student Collapses, Dies After Pack Of Stray Dogs Chases Him
stories.summary: The deceased, identified as Harshal Shinde, was a Class 12 science student. According to reports, he was returning home with his friends after tuition classes when a group of stray dogs chased them in the Shani Nagar area. In an attempt to escape, Shinde ran into a nearby shop and reportedly told the woman managing it that he had entered to save himself from the dogs.

stories.title: Priyanka Chopra pays tribute to victims of 26/11 terror attack in Mumbai, remembers heroes
stories.summary: Actor Priyanka Chopra paid tribute to the ones who lost their lives in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks at the Gateway of India on its 18th anniversary on Thursday. The actor took to her Instagram Stories and wrote, "Remembering the lives lost and the heroes who gave everything on 26/11.

stories.title: Mumbai pauses to remember 26/11 on 18th anniversary as leaders pay floral tributes to bravehearts
stories.summary: Mumbai, Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma and Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Thursday paid floral tributes at the city police headquarters to those who made the ultimate sacrifice while fighting terrorists during the Mumbai terror attacks 18 years ago. Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar, Director General of Police Sadanand Date, Mumbai Police Commissioner Deven Bharti and other officials were present on the occasion.

stories.title: Mumbai Book Festival: University showcases rare books dating back to 1960
stories.summary: The Mumbai University has put on display a collection of rare and select books, including publications dating back to the 1960s, at the ongoing Mumbai Book Festival 2026 . The collection includes books on the Indian economy, industrial development, the Constitution, history, literature, science and ancient knowledge systems.

stories.title: Mumbai Diary: Friday Dossier
stories.summary: Waterfront watcher An Egretta perches on a fishing boat at Versova Jetty as a ferry sails by. Pic/Satej Shinde A salute to the Constitution of India Yesterday, November 26, marked 77 years since the Constituent Assembly adopted India’s Constitution in the year 1949, with Dr BR Ambedkar and the Drafting Committee playing a pivotal role.

stories.title: 'If Katha Stops, Namaz & Church Prayers Will Also Stop': Bageshwar Dham Chief Dhirendra Shastri's Explosive Statement In Mumbai
stories.summary: Bageshwar Dham Peethadhishwar Dhirendra Krishna Shastri stated that religious discourses, or kathas, will continue across the country despite attempts to stop them, invoking constitutional protections for religious freedom. Speaking to the media in Mumbai on Thursday evening, Shastri said that if kathas were stopped, Islamic prayers and church prayers would also have to face similar restrictions.

stories.title: Race Cars In, Commuters Out: Navi Mumbai's Palm Beach Road Faces 13-Day Closure For Racing Festival
stories.summary: Adding to the problems of Navi Mumbai residents, a key stretch connecting Seawoods and Vashi on Palm Beach Road will remain closed to all vehicles for 13 days, from November 25 to December 7, in view of the Indian Racing Festival – Navi Mumbai Night Street Race and Formula 4 Indian Championship scheduled from December 4 to 6.

stories.title: Mumbai runners and cyclists choked by worsening AQI
stories.summary: Mumbai runners and cyclists are lacing up and hitting the streets again as the monsoon and pre-winter heat give way to cooler mornings. But as the city’s air turns increasingly polluted , the joy and comfort of outdoor exercise comes with a hidden health risk. From breathlessness and throat irritation to declining stamina, fitness enthusiasts say worsening AQI levels are taking a toll on their workouts.

stories.title: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh arrested on charges of harassing IAS officer
stories.summary: Kallakurichi MLA C. Arul Vignesh of the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) was arrested on Friday evening (November 27, 2026) by a police team on charges of harassing a woman IAS officer. The officer had accused him of making inappropriate advances and comments.

stories.title: Meerut hotel worker arrested after video purportedly shows him spitting on rotis
stories.summary: Holidays in Meerut | Public Holidays in Meerut | Meerut AQI | Weather in Meerut | Petrol Price in Meerut | Diesel Price in Meerut | CNG Price in Meerut | LPG Price in MeerutStay updated with the latest Meerut news.

stories.title: Union Cabinet Meeting Live: NCP to support NDA's delimitation bill, MLA Jitendra Ahwad says after meeting Sharad Pawar
stories.summary: Sources indicate that the Delimitation Bill is set to be uploaded on the Parliament Secretariat's official portal today. The move is expected to make the proposed legislation accessible to MPs ahead of further discussions and deliberations in Parliament. NCP-SCP leader Jitendra Awhad said Sanjay Raut's remarks reflected his personal views, stressing that Sharad Pawar's decisions remained final for party members.

stories.title: Chidambaram hits back at Shah over women's quota, says he may have 'amnesia'
stories.summary: Congress leader P Chidambaram on Friday criticised Union Home Minister Amit Shah over his remarks on the implementation of 33 per cent reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies, accusing him of being forgetful or economical with the truth. The former Union finance minister said the Congress had supported the passage of the women's reservation legislation in Parliament and had consistently demanded its immediate implementation.

stories.title: "One Community Favoured": Ex-Chief Justice BR Gavai To President On Judicial Picks
stories.summary: Former Chief Justice of India Bhushan R Gavai has written to President Droupadi Murmu alleging that the Supreme Court collegium is increasingly favouring candidates from “one particular section of the society” for elevation to constitutional courts, to the exclusion of scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, other backward classes, minorities and women.

stories.title: Samay Raina becomes first YouTube creator globally to cross 1 million channel members
stories.summary: Comedian Samay Raina found himself embroiled in a controversy in 2025 over his show, India's Got Latent, and had to remove all its episodes from his YouTube channel. In 2026, he made his much-awaited comeback with Still Alive and later launched the second season of India's Got Latent.

stories.title: Setback To TMC Rebel Camp As Calcutta HC Quashes Ritabrata Banerjee's LoP Appointment
stories.summary: In a setback to the Trinamool Congress rebel camp, the Calcutta High Court on Friday set aside the appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as the Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the West Bengal Assembly and directed the Speaker to take a fresh decision within 10 days.

stories.title: Gujarat ATS foils JeM attack plot, arrests Assam man with AK-47 rifle targeting Vadodara Air Force Station
stories.summary: The Gujarat Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) on Friday arrested a 22-year-old man allegedly linked to Pakistan-based terror outfit Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) for plotting an attack on a security establishment in the Vadodara district. An AK-47-type automatic assault rifle, two empty magazines, 23 live cartridges, a JeM flag, and approximately ₹ 20,000 in cash were recovered from his possession, officials added.

stories.title: Shiv Sena issues whip to MPs ahead of Parliament's special session
stories.summary: The Shiv Sena has issued a whip directing its MPs to attend the special sitting of Parliament beginning November 30, the party's chief whip Shrirang Barne said on Friday, reported the PTI. Barne said all party MPs have been instructed to reach Delhi by the night of November 29.

stories.title: Coffee planter killed in wild elephant attack in Kodagu, fourth death in Malnad region in a fortnight
stories.summary: A 48-year-old coffee planter was killed in a wild elephant attack at Badragola village in Ponnampet taluk of Kodagu district in Karnataka on November 26 morning. , a ritual, which was being performed following the celebration of Nerekattu on November 25 night. This is the fourth death in Malnad belt in man-elephant conflict in the last fortnight.

stories.title: Manipur man rescued 20 days after abduction, four arrested over ₹10 lakh ransom demand
stories.summary: Manipur Police rescued a 57-year-old man 20 days after he was abducted from Imphal East district and arrested four people in connection with the case, officers said on Friday, adding that the abductors had allegedly demanded a ransom of ₹ 10 lakh, but no money was paid.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh seeks 90% Central aid for ₹4,851-crore cyclone-resilient power project
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh Energy Minister Gottipati Ravikumar has sought 90% financial assistance from the Centre for a ₹4,851-crore project to strengthen the electricity distribution network in cyclone-prone coastal areas of the State. At a meeting with Union Power Minister Manohar Lal Khattar in New Delhi on Friday, Mr. Ravikumar explained the extensive damage caused to power infrastructure by recent cyclones Arnab and Murasu.

stories.title: London's 1814 Beer Flood: Brewery disaster killed eight in bizarre tragedy
stories.summary: Picture a normal Monday afternoon that goes sideways, with streets flooded not with rain or sewage but with thousands of gallons of beer. Sounds interesting? On October 17, 1814, the residents of a poor London neighborhood fought a deadly flood of dark porter when an enormous brewery vat ruptured, sending a torrent of beer into their homes and narrow streets.

stories.title: Shraddha Kapoor gained 10-12 kg for Eetha, pushed through gruelling rehearsals, recalls choreographer Vaibhavi Merchant
stories.summary: Choreographer Vaibhavi Merchant has opened up about the challenges of shooting the climax song of Shraddha Kapoor's upcoming film Eetha. She spoke about how Shraddha gained substantial weight to play the role of legendary Tamasha and Lavani artiste Vithabai Bhau Mang Narayangaonkar. She revealed that the weight gain made rehearsals more challenging and affected the actor's stamina.

stories.title: Sukesh Chandrashekhar serves legal notice to Netflix over documentary Love, Scam aur Dhokha; says it presents one-sided narrative
stories.summary: Alleged conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar has served a legal notice to the makers of the upcoming documentary, Love, Scam aur Dhokha : The Sukesh Chandrashekhar Story, based on his life and alleged fraud case. Sukesh has alleged that the documentary, set to stream on Netflix, presents a one-sided narrative of his life and has sought a deferral of its release until his case is completed.

stories.title: Class 11 Dropout Turns Doctor With ₹19.50 Lakh Fake Degrees, Rajasthan SOG Busts Multi-State Racket; 4 Arrested
stories.summary: Jaipur: Rajasthan Police's Special Operations Group (SOG) has busted a multi-state racket involved in fake medical degrees and securing registrations with medical councils. The racket allegedly supplied fake MBBS, MD (Gynaecology) and DMRD qualifications for lakhs of rupees and even arranged for them to be uploaded on university websites to make them appear genuine.

stories.title: "Don't Waste Court's Time": Supreme Court On Plea Against Ramayana Movie
stories.summary: Delhi: The Supreme Court on Friday declined to entertain an urgent listing request in a petition challenging the portrayal of the Hindu epic Ramayana in a movie, observing that there was no reason for immediate judicial intervention as the film had already hit theatres.

stories.title: Javed Akhtar blames alcohol for all the major mistakes of his life, says he lost 15 years
stories.summary: Veteran screenwriter and lyricist Javed Akhtar has often spoken candidly about his battle with alcoholism and the decision that changed his life. The writer, who gave up drinking in 1991, has now revisited that phase in a recent conversation, revealing that his drinking habit remains one of his biggest regrets.

stories.title: ASHAs’ strike: A test of the Congress government’s sensitivity
stories.summary: The indefinite strike by ASHAs in Bengaluru, which entered its 11th day on Friday (November 27), has become a political challenge for the Congress government. It brings to focus the apparent gap between the government’s stated commitment to healthcare and its approach towards women who work at the grassroots of the public health system.

stories.title: Saif Ali Khan takes trip down memory lane with old magazine covers co-starring Sridevi, Kareena Kapoor; fans are curious why he deleted it earlier
stories.summary: Saif Ali Khan is feeling nostalgic this Friday. He took to Instagram to share a bunch of old magazine covers from the 90s and early 2000s that featured him with his many co-stars of the time. Saif shared covers from popular tabloid magazines such as Filmfare, Stardust and CineBlitz.

stories.title: Seven Kuki civilians killed by militants laid to rest in Manipur’s Churachandpur after two months
stories.summary: “The mortal remains of seven Kuki civilians, who were killed by suspected militants in Manipur ’s Tamenglong and Noney districts in September, were laid to rest on Friday (November 27, 2026) at a cemetery in Churachandpur,” officials said. “The bodies, which had been kept at the mortuary of the Churachandpur district hospital, were taken to the Anglo Kuki War Memorial at D Vaison village for the funeral rites,” they said.

stories.title: Unlit Lamp, Contempt Notices: Supreme Court Pulls Up Tamil Nadu Officials Over Deepam Row
stories.summary: keveeyes New Delhi, Nov 27: The Supreme Court on Friday issued contempt of court notices to the Tamil Nadu Chief Secretary, the Director General of Police, officials of the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments (HR&CE) Department and other senior state authorities over the alleged wilful disobedience of its order permitting the lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp…

stories.title: 114 red sanders logs seized, three arrested in Kadapa anti-smuggling raids
stories.summary: Forest officials reportedly seized 114 red sanders logs and seven vehicles and arrested three persons during simultaneous raids at five locations in YSR Kadapa district as part of a crackdown on illegal smuggling on Friday. Deputy Chief Minister and Minister for Forest and Environment K. Pawan Kalyan congratulated the Kadapa District Forest Officer and his team for conducting the operation through coordinated and strategic action.

stories.title: RBI Deputy Governor Swaminathan J Urges Banks To Expedite Credit Sanctions To MSMEs, Promote Cash-Flow-Based Lending
stories.summary: Addressing the 31st meeting of the Standing Advisory Committee (SAC) in Kolkata to review the flow of credit to MSMEs, Swaminathan called for greater use of the Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) for receivables financing and early identification and resolution of stress. TReDS is an RBI-regulated online platform for discounting bills of MSMEs for supplies to large corporates.

stories.title: Dakshina Kannada administration, MIA conduct full-scale mock drill on aircraft crash
stories.summary: Dakshina Kannada district administration in coordination with Mangaluru International Airport (MIA) and multiple emergency-response agencies, conducted a full-scale integrated emergency drill on aircraft accident here on Friday, with guidance from National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA). The drill simulated a major aircraft accident outside the airport boundary and tested the coordinated response to a complex emergency.

stories.title: Attempt to set fire to Mother Mary statue in Chhattisgarh’s Narayanpur
stories.summary: Unidentified persons allegedly attempted to set fire to a statue of Mother Mary at Viswadeepti School in Chhattisgarh’s Narayanpur district on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), said a senior police officer on Friday (November 27, 2026). The incident took place in the same premises where former Narayanpur Superintendent of Police Sadanand Kumar was assaulted by a mob protesting against “forced conversions” in 2023.

stories.title: Bombay HC refuses to stall Tata Sons board meet amid dispute over Chandrasekaran’s reappointment
stories.summary: The Bombay high court on Friday declined to grant relief to Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) and RD Tata Trust (RDTT), seeking to restrain the board of Tata Sons from holding a meeting on November 30, where N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as executive chairman of Tata Sons for a third five-year term, along with other resolutions, is to be taken up for consideration.

stories.title: Union Budget 2027: Should government scrap LTCG tax and hike STT instead?
stories.summary: Proposals for the upcoming Budget 2027-28 focus on lowering or abolishing long-term capital gains tax. Industry bodies have differing views on changes to securities transaction tax that could replace revenue losses. SBI Research suggests raising the STT to offset losses if LTCG is abolished. PHDCCI, however, argues for halving the short-term capital gains tax while simultaneously reducing STT rates.

stories.title: No interim relief for Tata Trusts as Bombay HC refuses to halt Tata Sons board meet
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court has denied interim relief to Tata Trusts regarding the upcoming Tata Sons board meeting, scheduled for November 30. The court affirmed that this meeting will occur as planned. Tata Trusts are contesting the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as chairperson, citing the need for approval from their nominee directors, highlighting the ongoing power struggle within Tata Sons.

stories.title: Senior Citizens Should Not Need To Repeatedly Knock Doors Of Courts In Disputes With Banks, Says Bombay HC
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court on Thursday emphasised that senior citizens should not be forced to repeatedly approach courts to resolve disputes with banks and financial institutions. Observing that elderly customers often face unnecessary difficulties due to banks' indifferent handling of their grievances, the court called for a more considerate and accountable approach towards them.

stories.title: 'Mr C Joseph hates Sanatan': BJP hits out at Vijay govt after SC's Deepam rebuke
stories.summary: The BJP has strongly criticized the Tamil Nadu government for failing to comply with a Supreme Court order. This issue arose from the dispute over lighting the Karthigai Deepam lamp at Deepathoon. Senior officials received contempt notices from the Supreme Court due to non-compliance with its directive. The BJP claims the government's actions have offended Hindu devotees and hurt their sentiments.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
stories.summary: Two Italian nationals have died after an Iranian strike on a facility in Kuwait, Italy's foreign ministry has said. The pair were technicians working for German arms manufacturing company Rheinmetall, the ministry added. Kuwait's defence ministry earlier said that four people - the two Italians, a Kuwaiti national and Pakistani national - had been injured from falling shrapnel after a number of drones from Iran were detected and intercepted.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in drone attack in Kuwait
stories.summary: A drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians working on an air defence system on Thursday (November 276, 2026), marking the first fatal strike in the Gulf state for months. Both Italy and Kuwait confirmed the deaths, blaming the attack on Iran. But Tehran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi insisted in calls to his Kuwaiti and Italian counterparts that it was not behind the deadly strike.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power after storms hit US on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people are without power after severe weather hit both coasts of the United States during the Thanksgiving holiday. Eastern areas were lashed on Thursday by a powerful storm which brought high winds, heavy rain and coastal flooding. us. Conditions are forecast now to improve, though the National Weather Service (NWS) cautions that it will take some time.

stories.title: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind
stories.summary: India correspondent Published 9 hours ago Sheikh Hasina has repeatedly vowed to return to Bangladesh. Now the ousted prime minister has put a date on her homecoming - 16 December - and even outlined how she intends to make the journey. The government in Dhaka, which had previously dismissed the prospect, is taking her latest declaration more seriously.

stories.title: Donald Trump urges Vladimir Putin to end ‘military aggression’ in Europe
stories.summary: S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 26, 2026) he had asked Vladimir Putin to "pull back all military aggression" against Europe, in a fresh shift in tone towards the Russian leader he called his friend just last week. Mr. Trump said he had requested Mr.

stories.title: Japan space agency unveils Chandrayaan-5 rover prototype ahead of 2028 lunar mission
stories.summary: The Japanese Space Agency, JAXA, has unveiled the prototype of the rover for the Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX (LUnar Polar EXploration) mission. The Chandrayaan-5/LuPEX mission is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions to study the lunar volatile materials, including lunar water, in the vicinity of a Permanently Shadowed Region in the lunar South pole.

stories.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
stories.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky has voiced deep frustration with the US, criticising Donald Trump for calling Vladimir Putin "my friend" and saying delays in delivering vital anti-ballistic missiles were costing Ukrainian lives. In an interview with the BBC at his central Kyiv office, Ukraine's president complained the US was not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks, and called it "strange" that Trump posted a photo of himself embracing Putin.

stories.title: First look: Má Là Kitchen in Bengaluru is a love letter to China’s Sichuan province
stories.summary: I bite into a Sichuan peppercorn, and one side of my mouth is numb. It is almost like going to the dentist, but substantially more pleasing. You may be familiar with Sichuan cuisine in its many iterations that we see in India, like the infamous ‘Schezwan’ sauce.

stories.title: London Tube strike latest: Severe delays across most lines
stories.summary: The RMT union walkout - which ended at midday - saw several lines part suspended and the Waterloo & City line completely closed. Remind me, why are drivers striking? The strike may be over, but there's been no shortage of disruption for commuters trying to get around the capital.

stories.title: Pakistan set to host talks with Saudi Arabia, Turkey under trilateral defence pact
stories.summary: Pakistan is set to host talks with Saudi Arabia and Turkiye on Friday (November 27, 2026) under a trilateral defence pact that treats an attack on any member as an attack on all three, two security officials said. The talks in Islamabad will focus on developments in West Asia, including ongoing attacks on Saudi Arabia by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi rebels , the officials said.

stories.title: Massive fire at Bangkok oil refinery leaves several injured, Bangchak Corp shuts all units
